senses.sense_definition: A large, often colorful square of cloth worn as a head covering, neckerchief, or used as a handkerchief.

examples.text: She tied a bright red <w>bandana</w> around her hair to keep it out of her face.
The cowboy wore a dusty <w>bandana</w> around his neck to protect himself from the desert sun.

senses.sense_definition: A method of textile printing that creates white or light-colored patterns on a dark, dyed fabric using chemical discharge.

examples.text: The antique fabric was created using the traditional <w>bandana</w> printing process.
Historical records describe the <w>bandana</w> technique as a way to produce intricate spotted patterns on cotton.
